Technical Procedure
Equipment:
 Textile Expansion Joints
 Thermal textile
 Burgman
Introduction
This document outlines the inspection 
steps I1 for the textile expansion joints, which must be carried out when it 
consumed.
The technical data:
There are two types of joints ( wk1 at the frame after HRSG dampers & wk2 at the 
frame before HRSG chimney & wk3 under the drums of evaporators ), Wk1 : 
7 layers & wk3 : 5 layers & wk2 : 5 layers
The first draft initiated by eng. Abdo 
Abdo El Hendawy, tested by eng. Abdel 
Qader Fath Allah at 28 April 2003 on Boiler no. 
4 and revised by 
EDEPC quality control eng. Samir Abdel Gilel, accepted by general director eng. 
Sobhy Mohamed El Bakry 
and approved by eng. Moneer Mohamed El Wakeel Head Sector 
of Demiatta PS.
Safety Precautions
A work permit 
 must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable 
 safety category,
Safety fence 
 (rope) with caution marks surrounding the work area,
Wear safety 
 helmet, shoes.
A work permit 
 must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable 
 safety category,
HRSG out of service
Disconnect the power 
 supply of damper actuators and tagged it.
G .T. out of service and 
 ( excitation C.B & unit aux .C.B & low voltage trans .C.B ) is rack out
Mack scaffolding at the 
 joint if need
All safety precaution 
 must be followed by safety department.
Tools and Equipment
Drilling M/C & hook & keys kit
Special tools (needle & thermal thread & iron & thermal adhesive tap)
Air hammer, Bolts & washers
Work to be Carried Out
Lose the bolts of the joint.
Release the plates which on the joint.
Clean the tow flanges of the joint after remove the consumed 
 joint.
Install the new joint and tightening it.
